layout_year_intent: Current Grand Prix layout where the circuit is live; last Formula 1 layout where it is not. The mapped OpenStreetMap loop was selected by published length.

origin.meaning: Local source origin at the point on the loop nearest the venue coordinate, after rotation to the start.

projection: Local tangent plane, x east metres, y north metres. Vertical values are relative to the lowest smoothed sample on the lap.

route.scale_rule: Applied only when the mapped plan was within 1.5% of a published length. Larger gaps keep the mapped length.

elevation.dataset_note: Surface model, about 90 m, includes roofs and canopy. Not a bare-earth racing survey.
elevation.smoothing: Two circular binomial passes on the coarse samples, then linear interpolation onto the 4 m centreline. Isolated samples more than 6 m above their neighbours were treated as overpasses or roofs.
elevation.relative_datum: Heights stored after subtracting the lap minimum.

width.method: Authored from typical Grade 1 asphalt width, wider on low-curvature sections. Not a traced white-line survey.

shoulders.method: Nearest OSM barrier vertex on each side, median-smoothed, clamped to 1.2-24 m outside the kerb. Missing sides keep the venue default.

banking.method: Registered explicit signed station profile: Hugenholtz effective11.814028deg scalar approximation of actual4.5–19deg progressivebowl; T14negative18deg. Four-metre quintic transition samples.
limitations: Native TrackBankPoint stores one lateral slope per station: cannot represent progressive T3bowl or variable lateral tyre-contact normals. Both runtime collision and rendered road share this same plane, avoiding visual/contact disagreement.
Transition stations/shape and width are authored approximations, not lidar/as-built measurements.
Only banking profile changes; centerline, longitudinal elevation, widths and vehicle handling parameters are preserved.

primary_sources.claim: FIA2021racepreview: T3nineteen degrees and T14eighteen degrees.
Operator: T3progressivebowl and widened corner; T14eighteen degrees includingSAFER. Operator T3max18deg differs slightly from designer/FIA19deg; prefer designer for detailedcross-section.

buildings.method: OSM footprints within 14-85 m of the centreline, extruded to a tagged height or a default. Roof shape is flat.

protection: Both sides are walled at the shoulder offset. Pit entry is closed. That closure is a game boundary, not a claim about the real pit lane.
not_claimed: No lidar, no orthophoto registration, no cockpit capture in this build. Centimetre storage is not centimetre accuracy.
